sentences.text:
Opp. Party
 Mr.Tapas Kumar Praharaj,
 Standing Counsel

Coram:
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order

12.07.2024 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
02.
1.

This application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed in connection with Nalco Township P.S. Case No.155 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.718 of 2023, pending in the Court of the learned J.M.F.C., Banarpal where chargesheet dated 26.10.2023 has been submitted under Sections 365, 366, 370 (4), 376 - D, 376, 506, 109/34 of IPC and Section 25 and 27 of the Arms Act against the present petitioner, one Manoj Biswal @ Ranjan, Sibani Nayak and co-accused, Mita @ Bharati Biswal, Raja @ Rajesh, Pinu, Silu Khan, Sunil Nayak, Banti Nayak and three others, keeping the investigation open under Section 173 (8) of Cr.P.C.
2.
The prayer for bail of the petitioner has been rejected on 10.01.2024 by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge, Angul in BLAPL No.07 of 2024.

3. This BLAPL has been listed before me as BLAPL No.12953 of 2023 filed by the co-accused,
Ranjan @ Manoj Biswal has been disposed of by me on 16.11.2023.

4. Mr. Ashutosh Tripathy, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 28.08.2023 and on account of non-arrest of the co-accused persons trial has not commenced and he has been detained in custody.
He further submits that his prayer for bail may be considered sympathetically as false allegation have been made against him and initially he had not been named by the victim.
Prakash Bhutia @ Lulu Bhutia vs State Of Odisha .....

entities.text: Prakash Bhutia @ Lulu Bhutia vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Opp. Party on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22387237/
1 5.

Mr. T.K. Praharaj, learned Standing Counsel opposes the prayer for bail stating that the victim has named the petitioner in her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. to be involved in her gang rape and he has also been identified by the victim in the T.I. parade.
As the allegations against the petitioner are heinous in nature, he should not be released on bail.

6. Perused the two statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
7.

In view of the nature of allegations against the petitioner and as he has been identified in the T.I.
parade, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
8. The prayer for bail is accordingly rejected.

9. It is open for the petitioner to move the learned Court below for bail afresh in case there is undue delay in trial.
10.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.

(Savitri Ratho) Judge Bichi Signed by: BICHITRANANDA SAHOO Prakash Bhutia @ Lulu Bhutia vs State Of Odisha ..... Opp. Party on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22387237/
